title: Life Insurance Policy

origin.title: Sample Policy: Term Life Insurance (PAC ART, form P08TRM)
origin.clearance_note: A specimen policy Pacific Life publishes on its own domain, in a public sample-policies asset folder alongside other sample policies; downloaded directly by script on 2026-10-04. It is the carrier's own sample, stamped SAMPLE on every data page: the insured and owner are a 19th-century historical figure used as a placeholder, and the policy number is a dummy. The two officer signatures on page 1 are the carrier's corporate signatures as printed on its policy forms. All 14 pages are kept as published; only the PDF's document metadata was cleared, since it carried an author username.

notes: The request named no feature page or fields; its notes suggested face amount, initial monthly premium, policy date, risk class and policy number. Four of the five ship as suggested, all from the page 1 cover block. The policy date does not: the schema asks for ISO format, so 2008-05-01 grounds OFF against 'MAY 1, 2008'. It is replaced by the product type (TERM LIFE INSURANCE), which completes the story an underwriter or lender reads first: what kind of policy, which policy, how much cover, what it costs and at what rating. The insured's and owner's names read ok but are not featured; an impersonal field carries the same point. Every other OFF on the document is a normalized value (the ISO conversion, expiration and rider cease dates; the convertible and participating booleans; provision periods written as words, 'two years' and 'five years'). All 90 rows of the three premium tables on pages 5-7 ground ok.
